**Finding submitted: MFN — deviation (preferred-level cure proposed).**

- **No fee MFN either way.** Pricing runs off the per-ticket Monthly Notional Volume tiers, Supplemental Payments (33% of third-party earnings) and the rebate-share mechanic; none of these contains a best-terms undertaking, so the planner's "likely absent" read was correct as to pricing.
- **But Article XXII does burden us.** Under the Right of First Refusal (p0139–p0141) we must disclose any bonafide third-party offer to buy our assets or merge and give the Licensor a five-business-day first-refusal window before we may close. Per the playbook, a disclosure / right-to-match / most-favoured-offer mechanic is classified under MFN.
- **Fails every fallback element:** not limited to a defined product (it reaches whole-company M&A), runs for the entire term (36 months, extendable seven years at the Licensor's option, p0049) rather than 12 months, and has no like-for-like comparison carve-outs.
- **Cure (validated, minimality ok:true):** the Article XXII grant is replaced with an express "no right of first refusal, right to match or similar right," and the follow-on sentence is conformed to "The Licensee shall have the right to consummate the transaction with the third party," so no dangling "Right of First Refusal" or "Exercise Period" references remain and our freedom to close is preserved.
- The separate Change of Control consent right (p0134) is a different mechanic and was deliberately not flagged under this rule.
